code: library(cudacellr) library(Matrix)  set.seed(42) counts <- matrix(   rpois(60 * 30, lambda = 2),   nrow = 60,   ncol = 30,   dimnames = list(     paste0("gene_", seq_len(60)),     paste0("cell_", seq_len(30))   ) ) counts[1, ] <- counts[1, ] + 1 counts <- Matrix(counts, sparse = TRUE) normalized <- cuda_normalize_counts(counts) variable <- cuda_hvg(normalized, n_top = 20) pca <- cuda_cell_pca(   counts,   n_hvg = 20,   n_components = 5,   device = "cpu" ) neighbors <- cuda_cell_neighbors(   pca,   k = 5,   batch_size = 8,   device = "cpu" ) fit <- cudacell_workflow(   counts,   n_hvg = 20,   n_components = 5,   k = 5,   batch_size = 8,   device = "cpu" )  fit #> <cudacell_workflow features=60 cells=30 hvg=20 components=5 k=5 pca_device=cpu compute=cpu> class(fit$normalized) #> [1] "dgCMatrix" #> attr(,"package") #> [1] "Matrix" identical(rownames(fit$pca$x), colnames(counts)) #> [1] TRUE identical(rownames(fit$neighbors$index), colnames(counts)) #> [1] TRUE

title: Backend provenance and CUDA diagnostics
text: Normalization HVG calculations retain sparse Matrix storage. cuda_cell_pca() selects n_hvg rows materializes dense cell--feature matrix PCA. double copy selected matrix alone uses roughly 8 * cells * n_hvg bytes; centring, scaling, decomposition, CPU/GPU copies need additional working memory. Lower n_hvg lowering n_components dense input memory constraint, selected matrix allocated decomposition. Exact kNN remains quadratic time, retain complete cell--cell distance matrix. resident double distance block approximately 8 * min(batch_size, cells) * cells bytes, returned distances use 8 * cells * k bytes plus integer index matrix. Lower batch_size reduce peak memory; change neighbours.

title: Backend provenance and CUDA diagnostics
text: Normal R package checks must work without CUDA may conditionally skip optional example . cudaverse hardware contract separate: runs self-hosted runner labelled cuda, sets CUDAVERSE_REQUIRE_CUDA=true, verifies nvidia-smi, requires working torch CUDA runtime least one device, compares CPU CUDA PCA, kNN, complete single-cell workflow. also asserts CUDA stages present provenance aggregate workflow hybrid. marker can enforce local downstream hardware job: package CUDA workflow runs manually, automatically repository variable CUDAVERSE_NVIDIA_CI enabled. required hardware job missing CUDA fails; pass skipping GPU assertions.
code: require_cuda <- identical(   tolower(Sys.getenv("CUDAVERSE_REQUIRE_CUDA", unset = "false")),   "true" ) if (require_cuda && !isTRUE(diagnostics$cuda_available)) {   stop("CUDA hardware is required, but no usable device was detected.") }

title: cudacellr 0.2.0
text: Normalization, HVG selection, PCA, kNN now compose one ordered cudaverse-stage/1 provenance record, including upstream sparse materialization. cudacell_workflow() reports aggregate CPU/CUDA/hybrid compute device, print method longer implies PCA device represents complete workflow. Strict CUDA requests validated CPU preprocessing begins, avoiding expensive work unavailable-device error. Re-exported cuda_provenance() common inspector single-cell results.

title: cudacellr 0.1.2
